content: {"decision": "accept", "icd10_code": "E11.65", "code_display": "Type 2 DM with hyperglycemia", "guideline_citations": [{"url": "https://www.cms.gov/files/document/fy-2027-icd-10-cm-coding-guidelines.pdf", "quote": "The diabetes mellitus codes are combination codes that include the type of diabetes mellitus, the body system affected, and the complications affecting that body system...Assign as many codes from categories E08 – E13 as needed to identify all of the associated conditions that the patient has.", "source": "ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting FY 2027"}], "rationale": "Active statement \"Type 2 diabetes mellitus with hyperglycemia and it is active\" supports the code; HbA1c confirms hyperglycemia.", "physician_query_needed": false}
